summary: Baseball entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Baseball
entries.definitive_edition: Arcade Archives: Vs. Baseball on Nintendo Switch

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Mesen optional for NES comparison
emulation.notes: Primary route is official Switch Arcade Archives. Use NES emulation only for historical comparison footage.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Switch Arcade Archives HDMI capture for arcade version; NES emulator for home-version comparison

primary.why: The release family spans NES/Famicom, VS. System arcade, Game Boy, e-Reader, Virtual Console, and Nintendo Classics, with the VS. System arcade version having enhanced graphics and speech. Hamster's official Arcade Archives release is titled VS. Baseball on Switch, making it the cleanest official high-fidelity route; the NES/Famicom release remains the historical baseline but does not add exclusive content requiring a secondary run.
primary.how_to_play: Use Arcade Archives: Vs. Baseball on Nintendo Switch for the main archive capture. If documenting the historical home version, capture the NES/Famicom release separately as comparison rather than as required completion.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later Virtual Console and Nintendo Switch Online NES/Game Boy releases are reissues, not remasters. The Arcade Archives route represents the arcade version, so label any comparison capture clearly.
